sources.scope: 231 valid, distinct Ekurhuleni municipal stand references verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Tembisa WUP locator. GIS_KEY supplies native identity; every source component is retained and administrative references must agree. Complete object-ID manifests, three-row paging of the 45-row viewport and its full component refresh (fifteen geometry pages each), all 231 fresh identity reads, explicit absence, footprint and binding passed. Independent GEOS audit in EPSG:32735 found no invalid geometries, duplicates, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Stand S850000000000900000 retains eight disjoint components totalling about 1.963 km²; matching township/property/portion/SG references support its shared source identity. It is not excluded by size, flattened, clipped or repaired. Coverage, title, survey accuracy and identity beyond this bounded evidence are unverified.
